plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Public Health map for 2026-2027' and the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every row. This plan transcribes the program's only pathway, 'Public Health / Associate in Science for Transfer / 60-66 units / 4 terms / to CSU', in full; it is a Bakersfield College-only map with no CSU Bakersfield continuation shown ('to CSU' is the destination only) and no other pathway listed for this credential. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-66 units, and term totals as 16-17.5 / 16-17.5 / 13-15 / 15-16. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Statistics' (4-4.5) and 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4); Term 3 'Major List A' (4-5) and 'Area 3B : Humanities' (3-4); Term 4 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. PBHS B20, BIOL C1000, PBHS B21 and the Statistics, Major List A, Major List B and Major List C slots are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed' and are recorded with category 'major'. The 'CSU Transferable Elective' slot is printed once in each of Terms 1-3 and twice in Term 4 and is recorded as a separate choice slot in each occurrence exactly as printed. No row on the map shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag in Card View, so no prereqs are recorded. General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
